info.name: Larda - Complete Backend API
info.description:
# Larda frontend API test collection

Contains all 39 registered HTTP endpoints, plus ordered branches that demonstrate valid state transitions. Import this collection; the optional environment contains only base_url and demo identities. Collection defaults work without an environment.

## Run the full workflow
1. Start a seeded backend and PostgreSQL. Use backend AI_MODE=fallback for a free local demonstration. OPENAI_API_KEY belongs only in the backend .env. With AI_MODE=openai, task creation, answering, edits and retries may spend OpenAI credits.
2. Run folder **01 Full workflow** in Collection Runner with **one iteration and 1000 ms request delay**. Or run:
   `newman run postman/Larda.postman_collection.json --folder "01 Full workflow" --delay-request 1000 --timeout-request 10000`
3. Do not run requests in parallel. The collection creates fresh teams/tasks, discovers real tag/question IDs, captures response IDs and owner revisions, polls async AI, publishes a task, exercises team/captain changes, completes milestones and task, and handles cancellation on separate entities. Each run adds demo records and EXP and replaces the two students' tags.
4. Polls stop after poll_max_attempts (default 180) and fail/stop on failed AI. Only Runner/CLI/Newman follows setNextRequest loops; with Send, repeat polling manually until succeeded before continuing.
5. Run the optional retry folder separately when needed. Run only the named scenario folders, not the entire collection: the resource catalog contains manual requests and alternative lifecycle actions. Require a current Postman or Newman runtime with pm.execution.setNextRequest and pm.execution.skipRequest.

## Optional failed-AI retry
Set collection variable retry_task_id to an owned, editable task with ai_status=failed, then run folder **02 Optional failed AI retry** with the same delay. The folder verifies the precondition, retries, polls, then clears retry_task_id on success. It never assumes a reusable seeded failed task. Repair provider settings or choose explicit fallback first. Normal failure is not silently replaced with fallback.

## Browse endpoints by resource
Open **03 Endpoints by resource** for all 39 endpoints in Health, Users, Reference data, Tasks, AI, Teams, Proposals and Milestones. Use individual Send requests and fill the manual_* collection variables with real IDs and current revision. Each request documents access, preconditions and success status. These requests have no workflow scripts or automatic variable capture.

## Variables and identity
base_url is the origin only (default http://localhost:8080). Business=1, captain=2, ordinary student=3. Captain/student are globally students; captain permission is per-team. Public requests omit X-Demo-User-ID. There is no bearer token or OpenAI key in this collection.

Keep dynamic IDs/revision/answers as **collection variables**. Do not add them to an environment, globals or Runner data: higher-priority stale values can shadow captured values. Only owner task responses save revisions; public tasks have revision=0. In the automated scenario folders, success statuses are asserted exactly (200/201/202/204), JSON response shapes are checked, and 204 is checked for an empty body.

The collection tests valid workflows, not every negative authorization/concurrency case. Failed requests stop the current iteration to prevent cascading writes. For all payload/response contracts see ../json.md and ../for_frontend.md.

Postman workflow reference: https://learning.postman.com/docs/tests-and-scripts/running-collections/building-workflows
Postman execution reference: https://learning.postman.com/docs/tests-and-scripts/write-scripts/postman-sandbox-reference/pm-execution

item.name: 03 Endpoints by resource
item.description:
All 39 endpoints, grouped by resource for manual Send requests. This folder is an endpoint reference, not an ordered Runner scenario.

Set base_url and demo identities, then fill the relevant manual_* collection variables. Resource IDs start blank; copy real IDs from list/create responses. manual_user_id=3 and manual_revision=1 are examples. Refresh manual_revision using Tasks / Get task with the business header after changes. Edit bodies before sending, especially every question ID and answer in AI / Submit clarification answers.

Requests have headers and JSON examples but no workflow scripts, variable capture or automatic polling. Business=business_id, captain=captain_id, ordinary student=student_id; captain rights depend on the selected team. The variables are separate from the automated workflow.

Run only 01 Full workflow for the automated scenario, or 02 Optional failed AI retry for retry testing. Do not run the entire collection as a sequence: this reference contains alternative lifecycle actions. Use backend AI_MODE=fallback for local testing without OpenAI calls. See json.md and for_frontend.md for full contracts and application behavior.
